title: research: compose joint production tails and quantify credit distortion
body:
## Joint production and credit continuation

Separate marginal moment bounds can appear contractive while the actual joint process grows: the finite correlation control gives a marginal product `49/50` against the true joint moment `11/10`. This draft adds a conditional Cauchy–Schwarz interface over one history for adversarial ready credit, entry/carryover debt and honest pacer progress, preserving residual potential and predictable compensators.

The exact finite checker validates every declared state/action, with a separate adaptive Bellman first-crossing calculation and an independent Catalan first-passage control. A second note proves the ideal calibration-distortion lower bound `max(kappa_C,kappa_Q) >= R^(1/4)`. Its mathematical score witness is not a protocol proposal.

This remains stacked on #843 at `0ff81958a611d2c0be54d2ca839b955ae7cb2772`. The original native consensus, thresholds, signed domains, schemas, source pins and 13 open qualification obligations remain unchanged. The new test command runs exactly once under the existing CI omission/movement/multiplicity/failure-policy controls.

## Exact source and retained evidence

- **Tested source:** `4716bade250f327b012a098418f4eece6b73fcaa`; tree `bbc0278f87282d9bcf4e22b167040233516da310`.
- **Evidence-only child:** `29dd8eb7a1e127f44ce334673a5636e4fd7c58d8`; tree `932ca72a73b1ee374854c09ae493f175483f78f2`. Its 55 changed paths are confined to the evidence packet.
- [Evidence, limitations and recovery boundary](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/blob/29dd8eb7a1e127f44ce334673a5636e4fd7c58d8/evidence/pon-joint-production-tail-20261110/README.md)
- [37-file raw Python inventory](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/blob/29dd8eb7a1e127f44ce334673a5636e4fd7c58d8/evidence/pon-joint-production-tail-20261110/raw-python-manifest.json)

**299 fresh Python methods pass:** 27 new tail, 28 dynamic-participation, 34 qualification, 167 complete CI-contract and 43 source-integrity controls. Full before/after source verification checks all 26,224 entries / 2,502,336,628 bytes against the tested tree. Repository and CI gates pass; qualification consistency passes and promotion correctly refuses with exit 3. Publication verification checks the identical evidence tree and all 26,278 published tracked entries.

## Native execution and scientific limits

The original ROG request initially remained UNKNOWN after control-plane timeouts. A later exact same-controller/host/key/parameter recovery returned `reused=true` and original job `1a1c474c012-cf39-350`, durably **FAILED / exit 2** before setup: the unchanged 6 GiB free-space guard refused, with an empty command list. Complete original streams and the five-member raw archive are retained; no alternate native key or host was started. This closes execution ambiguity only: no Rust graph, format, Clippy or native test ran. The read-only source run `42778406804` still had all 18 jobs queued, with no steps, runner, conclusion or artifacts.

The earlier unpushed local `7f605fef...` source and raw logs were lost when the executor reset. This newly restored candidate is not presented as those original blobs or logs; historical conversation observations do not qualify it.

Complete legal-policy/state coverage, physical resource bounds, native-to-model reduction, quantitative clock/delivery/churn assumptions, actual production laws, CP/CG/CQ and lifetime composition remain unproved. Native six-successor and lifetime failure bounds remain null, and qualification remains **HOLD_NO_GO**. No merge or production activation is requested.

## Conditional marginal coupling evidence (2026-11-10)

[Evidence child a782b1b](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/blob/a782b1b501c9030d9f9f6fecd27b5858a702c9a8/evidence/pon-joint-production-tail-20261110/marginal-coupling/README.md) applies classical rearrangement to the same-history potential interface. The exact worst-coupling bound can pass at 9/10 when the Cauchy–Schwarz squared bound is 81/80. Seven standalone controls pass, including independent permutation and nonuniform transportation oracles; these are separate from the previously retained 299-method source suite. This is a research artifact only: installed formal checker, native code and CI semantics remain unchanged. Full conditional marginal laws still require proof; no native risk bound is supplied. The original ROG r1 recovery again returned a control-plane timeout, while the observed hosted jobs remained queued/pending. All qualification obligations remain open.


## Original r1 terminal recovery (2026-11-10)

[Complete evidence at 89030fc](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/blob/89030fceebbb0e02261bfe5eb1ec64313ab842d3/evidence/pon-joint-production-tail-20261110/r1-terminal/README.md) retains the original controller identity, complete byte-cursor streams, archive/version/checksum receipts and all five exact archive members. Original archive: 7,178 bytes, SHA256 `f804c99db721cff21206eabb4b54aff4628e9b624a8101a6a2091c43d0bc3000`. Final disk observation: 5,414,273,024 bytes free; minimum unchanged at 6,442,450,944. No Rust commands ran; the failed preparation is not a native-consensus failure or gate pass.

[Exact committed evidence checks](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/blob/89030fceebbb0e02261bfe5eb1ec64313ab842d3/evidence/pon-joint-production-tail-20261110/r1-terminal-validation/README.md) retain source verification of 26,323 entries / 2,503,727,712 bytes, repository/link, CI-contract and packet-reconciliation passes, with the distinct local/public commit identities and equal tree recorded. The initial wrong script-path command and its corrected pass both remain visible. The earlier 299-method source suite and seven coupling controls retain their original identities and were not rerun. Concurrent #868 owns the dynamic-input repair; it is not duplicated here. Both new commits are evidence-only, published with the authorized ProfHepta / 102159240 connector fallback after the Mac control-plane timeout, expected head `a782b1b...` and force=false. All 13 actual joint obligations remain open; native CP/CG/CQ, six-successor and lifetime bounds remain null; HOLD_NO_GO and no activation remain.


## Original source CI execution readback (2026-11-10)

[Original artifacts and terminal reconciliation](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/blob/dd3cb8776a0e3be668f5ce95dd6d5eded7f2f80e/evidence/pon-joint-production-tail-20261110/ci-original-42778406804/README.md) supersede the former all-queued observation. Original source run 42778406804 has eight completed failures, eight completed successes, two runtime jobs in progress and one queued consistency job at the retained snapshot. Repository-truth fails at the missing joint-qualification config inventory entry; quality refuses its dependency-policy graphs before Clippy. Protocol native execution completes five named children, but original confirmation acceptance fails: baseline 1/1 versus pressure 0/1 within the original four-second window. Three exact original artifact ZIPs, all member hashes, actual source/binary identities and four complete decoded job logs are retained. This is not a complete CI or native qualification pass. The failed Mac publication and authorized ProfHepta connector succession are preserved; the branch update used exact parent 89030fce and force=false. ROG r1 retains its separate FAILED/exit2 pre-setup result. No workflow was rerun, no native task resubmitted. All 13 actual joint obligations remain open, risk bounds null, HOLD_NO_GO and activation false.


## Embedded inventory repair and original runtime terminals (2026-11-10)

[Exact source and retained evidence](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/blob/3a4b46d567055ef1b90c74551661b750f2b35ee4/evidence/pon-joint-production-tail-20261110/inventory-fix/README.md) add the omitted existing joint-qualification config to the embedded native source inventory with the unchanged generator. Fresh source db9991c537e3469f1b7b6e1fa6f8466ac62edc4f passes all 299 retained Python methods, inventory, repository/CI-contract checks, full before/after source verification and expected promotion refusal. New-source Rust graph/format/Clippy/native results are unobserved and must be collected separately. Original source 4716 and its original preview bca89 both now have successful hosted runtime shards, with all ten consensus arithmetic/time tests observed passing; their exact ZIP receipts and full logs are retained separately. No original ROG r1 result is relabeled. Original quality-policy and business-confirmation failures remain. All thirteen actual joint obligations remain open and HOLD_NO_GO remains; no activation or merge.


## Conditional bad-event composition evidence (2026-11-10)

[Proof and exact finite controls](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/blob/341b7b6195a44d3f4a758c98f846457567ac1de3/evidence/pon-joint-production-tail-20261110/killed-bad-events/README.md) specialize killed good-subkernel martingales, predictable bad-event spending and adaptive claim union bounds to the existing A+E-J interface. Actual conditional probability mass is retained; eventual-good trajectories are not used as a replacement law. Seven new standalone methods pass, including an independent tiny policy-tree oracle, residual-state and renormalization controls. A finite control has exact union probability 1/4 against certified upper 1/2; neither is a native risk estimate. Exact executed artifact source is 85905b41943cd872fbaedbcfe19ea753839847ef. Source/repository/CI-contract checks pass, promotion still refuses, and raw receipts are retained. The installed formal checker, native code, source pins, thresholds and CI semantics are unchanged. Actual good laws, bad-event coverage/timing/hazards, resource/operator reductions and native failure mapping remain unproved. All thirteen actual joint obligations remain open, native risk bounds null, HOLD_NO_GO and activation false.
